content: E2E vs remote MCP (derived from official Claude connector docs + IETF draft-li-pearg-ciphertext-inference-tool-mcp-00): Claude reaches remote connectors from Anthropic cloud (not user device); tool arguments (send) and tool results (read) are plaintext at the MCP server and at Anthropic. No standard gives the model plaintext while the remote server stays blind. Channels for user-held key material: OAuth tokens issued by own AS (viable, opaque token can embed a wrapping secret), request headers (beta, limited orgs, not consumer-viable), tool arguments (unsafe). Client-side decryption possible only via local MCP (MCPB Desktop macOS/Windows, Claude Code stdio), Chrome extension (web only), or MCP App app-tools (result goes view->Claude, 100k chars, but gated per organization, web unified experience, view must stay loaded).
